meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任务计划和进度存成文件,清空对话后也能无缝接着干。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做需要多步骤完成的编程或研究任务,又担心对话记录被清空。
copy.tagline_en: Save plans and progress to files so your AI agent can resume after clearing the chat.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run long multi-step coding tasks and worry about losing context.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在项目目录创建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 文件,把计划、研究发现和进度写在磁盘上;动手前先读计划,每完成一个阶段就更新文件、记录错误,并在对话被清空后自动恢复计划。
howto.when: 当你要求它规划、拆分或组织多步骤项目、研究任务,或工作预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时;对话被 /clear 清空后会尝试恢复已有计划。

say.text: 帮我规划这个多步骤项目,先创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会建立计划文件并逐步更新进度。

say.text: 这个研究任务步骤很多,建好 findings.md 并记录发现。
say.note: 后续研究会持续写入文件。

say.text: 先检查之前的计划进度,再继续任务。
say.note: Claude 会读取磁盘上的计划文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md in the project directory to store plans, findings, and progress on disk. It reads the plan before acting, updates the files after each phase, logs errors, and resumes plans after /clear or context loss.
howto.when_en: When you ask it to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. It also attempts to recover existing plans after /clear.

say_en.text: Please plan this multi-step project and create task_plan.md first.
say_en.note: Claude will create the plan file and update progress.

say_en.text: This research task has many steps; create findings.md and record findings.
say_en.note: Findings will be saved to the file as it works.

say_en.text: Check the existing plan progress first, then continue the task.
say_en.note: Claude will read the plan files on disk.
